records.title: New enterprises under Stand-up India Scheme
details: Hon. Speaker, Sir, I appreciate the question raised by the hon. Member. Yes, this scheme was up to 31st March, 2025. It was announced in the Budget that it would be extended, and subsequently, with that extension, it was to continue till 31st March, 2025. But let me inform the Member that, learning lessons from the implementation of the scheme which ran till 31st March 2025, and based on the studies undertaken by NITI Aayog and other, the scheme is presently being redrafted. Soon, a proposal will be placed before the Cabinet, following which we will launch a new scheme to continue with the Stand-Up India Scheme which has benefited SCs, STs, and Women across the country wherever there is a bank branch.
